classifications.reason: The closed enumeration admits persons afoot, wheelchair users and qualifying mobility-device users, not persons riding bicycles.
The closed enumeration of qualifying persons leaves out buses as described by the class contract.
The contract requires a child pedestrian, and the admitting enumeration imposes no age restriction.
The closed enumeration leaves out vehicles classified by commercial mass or licensing.
The closed enumeration does not admit persons riding bicycles with assisting electric motors.

Every scooter rider admitted through the cross-referenced mobility-device definition is on a device the jurisdiction treats as on foot and thus satisfies the quoted contract of the proposed included covering class ru.pedestrian.
The closed enumeration leaves out emergency vehicles, regardless of their designation or responding conduct.
Fire-fighting vehicles fall outside the closed enumeration of qualifying persons.
The closed enumeration does not admit persons riding the low-power vehicles described by the moped contract.
The closed enumeration of qualifying persons does not admit the motor-vehicle class described by this contract.
Persons riding astride two- or three-wheeled motorcycles are outside the closed enumeration.
The closed enumeration leaves out vehicles identified by official or contracted road service.
The enumeration admits persons on foot, in manual or motorized wheelchairs, and on the specified devices treated as on foot, matching the class contract.
The contract requires a pedestrian, and the definition contains no exception for a cane, guide animal or accompanying person.
Trains, trams, streetcars and other on-track equipment are outside the closed enumeration of qualifying persons.
The closed enumeration leaves out buses designated and marked for carrying school children.
Passenger vehicles for hire are outside the closed enumeration of qualifying persons.
Neither tour or shuttle buses nor lengthened passenger vehicles for hire fall within the closed enumeration.
Vehicles drawn by another vehicle and vehicle combinations are outside the closed enumeration of qualifying persons.
The closed enumeration leaves out buses in public transit service.
Motor vehicles built for carrying goods are outside the closed enumeration of qualifying persons.
